text: Program Description 1. Teaching Objective​ Editor Notes: With basic knowledge learning and traning, students are to become professional in mechanical and electrical engineering and related fields. The students are trained with the basic theory of professionals in the field of mechanical and electrical engineering, mechanics, microelectronics, technology of power electronics, computer technology, basic knowledge of mechanical and electrical integration; Trained by senior engineers, students will obtain the basic ability to design, test and use of mechatronic products; Ability to make research and develop new electromechanical integration products; Ability to master the basic theories and skills of computer aided design, testing and manufacturing; The basic ability of technical and economic analysis and production organization and management of mechanical and electrical products. 2. Course Structure ​ Editor Notes: We can see both main courses and laboratory courses of Mechatronics Engineering among the four years. Course Name Credits Advanced Mathematics I 5.0 Advanced Mathematics II 5.0 Theoretical Mechanics 5.0 Material Michanics 4.5 Analog electronic circuits 4.0 Mechanism and Machine Theory 3.5 Single-chip Microcomputer Principle and Interface Technology of Mechatronics System 4.0 Machinery Design 3.5 Mechanical Manufacturing Engineering 3.0 Courses arrangements and credits as well as Laboratory Courses in detail.>> 3. Career and Internship Editor Notes: Students mainly become engineerings in related fields. Graduates can be the senior engineers engaged in the management of mechanical equipment; design of electronic and mechanical products; development and computer aided design of mechanical and electrical products. 4. School Introduction​ Editor Notes: SAU is a key university in Liaoning Province. Shenyang Aerospace University has developed into an academic Centre. SAU is proud of its practical teaching system which includes basic, professional and general practice. There are numerous first-rate labs for the students, some at national levels. Learn More >> 5. College of Mechanical Electrical Engineering​ Editor Notes: The College of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering boasts strong teaching ability and featured disciplines. College of Mechanical Electrical Engineering is one of the first professional Schools for training a large number of National Aviation Industry professionals and technical personnel, which made great contributions to the development of National defense engineering. The school has two master's degrees of machinery manufacturing and automation, mechanical design and theory (key supporting discipline of Liaoning Province), master of mechanical engineering and two levels of undergraduate degrees. 6. Facilities Editor Notes: SAU owns a number of advanced labs and research centres. The Key Laboratory of Experimental Center has a number of advanced equipments, including vertical machining center, precision EDM Machine, YAG laser processing machines, precision EDM, rapid prototyping machines and 10 sets high-level equipments. There are two key provincial laborites which can provide students more opportunities and facilities to make research in the colleague. 1) Electromechanical transmission and control lab This lab is equipped with five electromechanical transmission and control test beds typed with RTJLN-4 which offers students to take tests here. 2) PLC lab This lab is equipped with twenty-five comprehensive test equipments type with SAC-PLC/51 and two OU PENG 3D progress test-beds and two OU PENG 3D test beds which can simulate industrial environment. 7. The teaching team of College of Mechanical Engineering are active in academic thinking and good overall quality. The main objective of the school is teaching promotes research, research promote teaching. In the past three years, a total of 60 research projects were undertaken and completed.
